requirements_summary: SMB e-commerce with ~10k SKUs. Primary goals: (1) generate concise on-brand product descriptions and bullet attributes (2) build a product Q&A microservice for product pages (3) rerank Shopify search results to surface high-converting SKUs. Latency: target 100-300ms p95 for product page Q&A; background enrichment can be async (hours). Throughput: bursty — up to 800 requests/min for new drops, typical steady-state 10–30 reqs/min. Cost sensitivity: high — wants batching + caching recommendations. Model preferences: open models that balance cost and coherence (gpt-like mid-size / llama variants acceptable). Routing/fallback: must have smaller/faster model fallback for bursts, and simple cached responses for repeated queries. Data handling: no long-term storage of customer queries in production; retention controls required. Authentication: SSO/SAML for staging before go-live. Observability: token-level cost estimation useful.
